title: 광업ㆍ제조업조사 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Survey Unit and Method)
(1) The Mining and Manufacturing Survey shall be conducted as a complete enumeration or sample survey by establishment.
(2) The representative of an establishment subject to survey or a person equivalent thereto shall be the respondent.
(3) The Mining and Manufacturing Survey shall be conducted by interview by survey personnel employed pursuant to Article 10: Provided, That where the Administrator of the National Data Agency deems necessary, it may be conducted by self-enumeration through the Internet, mail, or other means. <Amended on November 9, 2021; October 1, 2025>
(4) The Administrator of the National Data Agency may prepare statistics by utilizing, together with data obtained under paragraph (3), administrative data provided pursuant to Article 24 of the Statistics Act. <Newly Inserted on November 9, 2021; October 1, 2025>
